verdict.rationale: Temporal is workflows-as-code rather than a visual builder, but testing workflows before going live is still a fair axis for a workflow engine. The evidence offers only indirect support: a local dev server with a Web UI for viewing sample workflow executions, and a CLI described as letting you monitor and debug with fast local feedback. Nothing documents per-step input/output inspection or pinned test data. missing for 10: pinned or sample-data test runs, per-step input/output inspection, a documented testing framework, hands-on corroboration.
